hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that fully handles swaps in beforeSwap by depositing input tokens into an Euler vault, withdrawing output tokens from another Euler vault, and verifying a bonding curve invariant via CurveLib. Uses BeforeSwapDelta to bypass PoolManager internal pricing entirely, implementing a Uniswap v2-style swap interface backed by Euler credit accounts.
